reviewItem.question: Does "The flag `k8s-mode` (and related flags `cilium-agent-container-name`, `k8s-namespace` & `k8s-label`) have been deprecated and will be removed in a Cilium 1.18" mean a change to cli-flag:cilium|name=--k8s-mode (deprecated)?

proposed.statement: The bugtool flag --k8s-mode (and related --cilium-agent-container-name, --k8s-namespace, --k8s-label) is deprecated and will be removed in Cilium 1.18; use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster.
